resources.string: Local examples use real feature controllers and fixed sample records. Choose your task, implement its helper, rebuild debug, and reopen the example. No Firebase setup is needed.
Feature examples pending: cancellation/rejection actions (B7), Android alerts and notification entry (B8), and administration (B9). These paths are not simulated here.
Helper not connected. The lead connects the real function in the task handoff. This example does not supply its answer.
Assigned function connected. Other unfinished helpers use fixed fixture outcomes in this example only.
Example pending baseline %1$s. Its feature or handoff contract is still in progress.
This task is a planning placeholder. Instructions and a working example will be supplied with its baseline.
Saved locally. Reset example restores the starting records.
Clear the name and save to see required feedback. Then save “ Alex Chen ”: the local account should contain “Alex Chen”.
Blank contacts should clear their saved values. “alex@example.com” is valid; “alex@@example.com” is invalid. Try “+1 (780) 555-0100” and then “letters” for the phone.
The calendar starts in May 2027. Select May 11 and Withdraw, then Save. Only changed dates should be submitted. May 13 is booked and cannot be changed. Saves affect this example only.
Published starts with River Camp, Alpine Meadow, and Forest Clearing. The connected helper should order Alpine, Forest, River. Inspect only; no campsite creation is needed.
Search for “river”: only River Camp should remain. “quiet” matches its description. Clear search to see all three listings. Guest matching and ordering use supplied outcomes here.
Open Filters. Apply 5 guests: River Camp and Forest Clearing remain. Apply 9: no listings remain. Text matching uses a fixed match here.
Try Valid, Registration reversed, Booking overlaps, and Booking reversed. These are supplied instants; the real validator produces the result below. This example does not save or publish a lottery.
Choose All participants, Selected, or Not selected. The two supplied entries should be filtered by exact state. Both belong to the displayed completed draw.
Three events start shuffled. The newest is “task-new”; “task-a” and “task-b” share a time and sort by ID. Tap a row to inspect its supplied saved record.
Three receipts contain two unread entries. Open either unread event: its local receipt becomes read and the count drops. Ordering uses the supplied fixture order.

A winning entrant is already loaded. In May 2027, May 11–12 are offered and free; May 13 is booked; May 14 has no calendar record. Inspect date selection here. Booking submission is outside this example.
With local today May 10, 2027, two stays are Upcoming and one is Past. Only the two active stays appear. Ordering uses the supplied fixture order.
The active stays start shuffled: May 14, then May 11. The helper should display May 11 first. Category decisions are fixed fixture facts here.
Sample record unavailable. Reset the example to restore its records.
